planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno. PWM LED output is wired to D9 as required; PWM is also physically capable on other Uno pins but they are not required by the given inventory.
Light level threshold stated as >800 is a model/business parameter. Hardware request only provides A0 ADC input and D9 PWM output.
Buzzer condition (light extremely strong >800) and buzzer pulse width/frequency are modeled as business logic with real elapsed time; tone_output pin D6 is reserved.

D13 appears in the provided authoritative inventory as a digital_output role. The prose did not describe its business behavior; it is represented electrically as a program-owned digital output with default initial=false.
No serial requirements were provided; therefore no serial channels or serial inputs/outputs are added.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Light sensor (photoresistor) level; model converts higher value => brighter environment

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: PWM LED brightness: light stronger => LED dimmer (model computes inverted mapping)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer short鸣提示 when light extremely strong (>800) (model controls frequency and duration)

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: D13 indicator output (role present in inventory; model decides usage)
